mapper.select: SELECT es.session_id AS sessionId, et.body_part AS bodyPart, es.total_count AS totalCount, es.duration_sec AS durationSec, es.accuracy AS accuracy, es.video_path AS videoPath, es.exercise_date AS exerciseDate FROM EXERCISE_SESSION es JOIN EXERCISE_TYPE et ON es.exercise_type_id = et.exercise_type_id WHERE es.user_id = #{userId} AND es.exercise_date = CURDATE() ORDER BY es.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT es.session_id AS sessionId, et.body_part AS bodyPart, es.total_count AS totalCount, es.duration_sec AS durationSec, es.accuracy AS accuracy, es.video_path AS videoPath, es.exercise_date AS exerciseDate FROM EXERCISE_SESSION es JOIN EXERCISE_TYPE et ON es.exercise_type_id = et.exercise_type_id WHERE es.user_id = #{userId} AND es.exercise_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY es.exercise_date DESC, es.created_at DESC

SELECT es.session_id AS sessionId, et.body_part AS bodyPart, es.total_count AS totalCount, es.duration_sec AS durationSec, es.accuracy AS accuracy, es.video_path AS videoPath, es.exercise_date AS exerciseDate FROM EXERCISE_SESSION es JOIN EXERCISE_TYPE et ON es.exercise_type_id = et.exercise_type_id WHERE es.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY es.exercise_date DESC, es.created_at DESC

SELECT es.session_id AS sessionId, et.body_part AS bodyPart, es.total_count AS totalCount, es.duration_sec AS durationSec, es.accuracy AS accuracy, es.video_path AS videoPath, es.exercise_date AS exerciseDate FROM EXERCISE_SESSION es JOIN EXERCISE_TYPE et ON es.exercise_type_id = et.exercise_type_id WHERE es.user_id = #{userId} AND es.exercise_date = #{date} ORDER BY es.created_at DESC

SELECT es.session_id AS sessionId, et.body_part AS bodyPart, es.total_count AS totalCount, es.duration_sec AS durationSec, es.accuracy AS accuracy, es.video_path AS videoPath, es.exercise_date AS exerciseDate FROM EXERCISE_SESSION es JOIN EXERCISE_TYPE et ON es.exercise_type_id = et.exercise_type_id WHERE es.user_id = #{userId} AND es.session_id = #{sessionId}
